cases.name: AutoLoop process crash (SIGKILL/SIGSEGV)
cases.stack_a: resumeAutoLoop recovers from last safe checkpoint; writer-phase crash -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED (fail closed)
cases.recoverySemantics: at-least-once with idempotent side effects; completed work never lost (D1)

cases.name: SIGTERM graceful termination
cases.stack_a: abort path leaves consistent checkpoint (test 32)

cases.name: machine reboot
cases.stack_a: checkpoint + journal on local disk; resume after boot; repository fingerprint must still match (worktree must be clean)
cases.recoverySemantics: at-least-once; fingerprint gate fails closed on repo drift

cases.name: sub-agent / executor container crash
cases.stack_a: EXECUTOR_ERROR -> HOLD journaled; repair budget decremented; retry within budget
cases.recoverySemantics: retry with budget; EXECUTOR_ERROR is not PASS (D2)

cases.name: writer crash mid-mutation
cases.stack_a: interrupted writer -> HOLD/RECOVERY_REQUIRED; never blindly replayed (D3)
cases.recoverySemantics: no auto-replay of writer mutation; manual/authority recovery

cases.name: reviewer crash
cases.stack_a: REVIEWER_COMPLETED checkpoint boundary; crash before -> phase re-runs review (read-only)
cases.recoverySemantics: at-least-once for read-only review; review is idempotent

cases.name: Colima restart / docker socket unavailable
cases.stack_a: n/a (durable path adapters)
cases.recoverySemantics: retry within budget; container cleanup idempotent

cases.name: worktree exists but controller died
cases.stack_a: worktree identity pinned in fingerprint; writer resume refused
cases.stack_b: worktree dir persists; prepareWorktree idempotent reuses it

cases.name: stale writer lease
cases.stack_a: lease holder persisted in checkpoint; stale remnant -> RESUME_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH (fail closed)
cases.stack_b: in-memory lease; lost on crash (no stale lease on restart)

cases.name: checkpoint partial write
cases.stack_a: atomic replace under lock + checksum + CAS revision; partial write detected on read

cases.name: corrupted checkpoint (checksum tamper)
cases.stack_a: test 8 detects; resume rejects (CORRUPT)

cases.name: journal ahead / database behind
cases.stack_a: journal hash chain is canonical; checkpoint references journal head; mismatch -> RESUME_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH
cases.stack_b: CBM-4 memory store: sqlite subset of journal -> lossless rebuild

cases.name: stale execution record
cases.stack_a: execution identity deterministic; resume of terminal run returns COMPLETE (idempotent)

cases.name: provider timeout
cases.stack_a: EXECUTOR_TIMEOUT -> HOLD journaled

cases.name: network outage / API retry
cases.stack_a: adapter-level; no durable-specific handling
cases.recoverySemantics: caller/adapter responsibility; no silent retry of writer effects

cases.name: crash before node start
cases.stack_a: PHASE_READY not journaled -> resume replays phase start (read-only safe)

cases.name: crash during node execution
cases.stack_a: read-only requeue; writer -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED

cases.name: crash after result before persistence
cases.stack_a: result not journaled -> phase re-runs (read-only)

cases.name: crash after persistence before successor scheduling
cases.stack_a: PHASE_PASSED journaled + checkpoint -> successor scheduled on resume (D5)

cases.name: crash during review
cases.stack_a: REVIEWER_COMPLETED boundary; review is read-only idempotent

cases.name: crash during repair
cases.stack_a: PHASE_REPAIR_REQUESTED journaled; attempt persisted; budget preserved (D4)

cases.name: crash before/after memory write-back
cases.stack_a: n/a (write-back not wired)
cases.stack_b: CBM-4 idempotent gate: journal-first; duplicate -> WRITEBACK_DUPLICATE (D6)

cases.name: crash before closeout
cases.stack_a: manifest finalization at terminal; crash before -> run not terminal, resumable
cases.stack_b: closeout evidence written post-final; crash before -> re-run
cases.recoverySemantics: no terminal claim without terminal journal (D1/D2)

exactlyOnceWhereRequired: completed node result must not be lost (D1) and must not be re-promoted (D2) — satisfied by terminal journal + checkpoint + resume in STACK_A; NOT satisfied by STACK_B
writer side effects: never blindly replayed (D3) — STACK_A fail-closed; STACK_B relies on worktree + in-memory lease
memory write-back: idempotent (D6) — satisfied by CBM-4 gate
telemetry: replay-aware (D7) — GAP at STACK_A durable layer (no replay marker); STACK_B post-final observer is single-shot
